notes.title: Is the board more than features?
notes.body: Ideas, research and references evaporate in chat the same way parked work does. Decided: questions are cards (they have a next step and an end), brainstorms/plans/references are notes (they don't). Not a new product category — two collections behind five tabs.

notes.title: Board UI review: builder and PM walkthrough
notes.body: Built first (LE-30): Done / Needs work, autosave, proof links, undo, honest progress, new-since-you-looked dots, what was considered, linked notes, copy prompt, bulk actions, one word everywhere, a timeline that shows waiting, ~ paths. The rest stay as ideas.
notes.considered: 28 suggestions from a builder and a PM walkthrough. You picked 15 to build first (LE-30); the other 13 wait here as ideas, LE-31 to LE-43.

notes.title: Landing page design direction
notes.body: Dark by default, with a light switch; the hero terminal stays dark in both. Schibsted Grotesk for text and JetBrains Mono for code. The hero is text on the left and a small example board on the right; the changing word under the headline is typed as inline code in one colour. The session terminal lives under the hood, beside the hooks table. Real screenshots come from this project's own board, in both themes.
notes.considered: Bricolage Grotesque with IBM Plex: read as childish. Geist and Geist Mono: flagged as overused. A terminal in the hero: it showed code instead of value, so it moved down. A rainbow of colours on the typed word: one colour reads more technical.

notes.title: How the landing site deploys
notes.body: Vercel project 'clipped', Root Directory 'landing', connected to github.com/avivalushai/clipped: every push to main deploys to useclipped.vercel.app. The Vercel GitHub app only sees the repos picked in its settings. A manual deploy runs from the repo root: npx vercel --prod.

notes.title: Amplitude for the website
notes.body: EU project; key in landing/analytics.js (a public browser key). Tracks page views plus: Install method chosen, Install command copied, Install button clicked, Install guide opened, GitHub clicked, FAQ opened — each with page and a short label. No cookies (localStorage), IP addresses off, nothing sent from localhost (events go to window.__events there).
